text:
jen: Kicking off an edge blue->green swap in the 22:00 UTC change window. Plan: 10% weight steps every 2m, verify p95 and 5xx at each step. Rollback triggers: >1% absolute 5xx increase from baseline OR p95 latency > +200ms for 3 consecutive checks. I'll run the weight changes, @oncall please ack and watch.
sam: preflight: canary health = OK, kv-cache primed, session-drain script staged. Containers ready on green pool.
marta: dashboards: router.p95 and router.5xx_rate watches set, alert thresholds configured. I'll be watching for the first 10m.
kai: Oncall acked. If we need to revert I will execute the fallback route into the legacy path and drop green to 0. Rollback command (internal):
```
# shrink green to 0 and route to fallback
curl -X POST https://router-api.internal/v1/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"pool":"edge-green","weight":0}'
```
I'll also toggle circuit-breaker to strict if error spike > 2%.
nora: Note: pinned model for dedicated tenants -> v2.1.3 during the window to avoid on-the-fly reloads. Confirmed with model-onboard team.
sam: autoscaler note: bumped minReplicas=3 for green so we don't scale-in mid-shift.
jen: starting step 1 -> 10% now. Deploy-bot, post step progress and health snapshot.
deploy-bot: [automation] traffic-shift job queued by jen. Starting step 1: set edge-green=10%. Gathering metrics for 120s.
deploy-bot: [automation] metrics snapshot after step 1: 5xx rate = baseline +0.02%, p95 = baseline +8ms. No alerts triggered.
marta: looks clean so far, proceed.
jen: advancing to 30% (skip 20 to converge faster); will pause at 30 for extra 2m.
deploy-bot: step 2 complete: edge-green=30%. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: step check: 5xx +0.05%, p95 +12ms. Still within bounds.
kai: Watcher here. If we see sustained >0.8% absolute 5xx, we rollback. I have the rollback command at hand.
nora: small note — session stickiness is off, so some user sessions might re-create ephemeral state. Teams aware.
jen: continuing to 60%.
deploy-bot: edge-green=60%. Snapshot: 5xx +0.2%, p95 +40ms. No sustained threshold breaches.
sam: Seeing a small uptick on one POP (iad). Holding 60 for an extra 2m to confirm stability.
marta: iad POP spike looks transient; errors trending back down.
jen: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: final shift complete: edge-green=100%, edge-blue=0%. All checks OK. Marking change completed in console. :tada:
kai: Confirmed rollback not required. Will keep an eye on long-tail p95 during the night.
jen: Thanks everyone. I'll update release notes with the swap details and the rollback criteria. If any post-change regressions show up please @eng-oncall and tag this thread.
marta: Added brief note to incident timeline: no anomalies, change window closed.
deploy-bot: [automation] change_event: closed by jen. Link: https://console.internal/changes/1919000000
